hints.title: Sign Distinguishes Greedy Direction
hints.text: For positive numbers, place x before the first digit strictly smaller than x.

hints.title: Negative Number Strategy
hints.text: For negative numbers, place x before the first digit strictly larger than x to keep the magnitude minimal.

hints.title: Fallback Insertion at Tail
hints.text: If no such position is found, append digit x to the end of the number string.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: L is length of string n
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all insertion positions with numerical comparison causes memory limit exceeded for strings of length 10^5.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A single linear scan identifies the greedy insertion index in O(L) time and space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate handles negative sign properly by finding first digit greater than x.
